The '''TT-8L/XSS''' was the top of the line version of the [[TT-8L gatekeeper droid/Legends|TT-8L gatekeeper droid]].

==Description==
The TT-8L/XSS consisted of a [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like, two-and-a-half [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long body created out of antique [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]] that was decorated with intricate scrollwork, silver trim and inlaid synthetic [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was bolted to the floor with multiple joints to allow a limited range of movement. It had a single [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|optical sensor]] that was protected by a bronze shutter and functioned in a similar manner to [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]]. The droid was equipped with a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] that gave the unit a mellow voice with a courteous manner and diction.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
The XSS was produced by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid]] as a variant of their popular TT-8L line. [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal staff procured a large number of TT-8L/XSS for use on the resort [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]].<ref name="EGTD" />
